about: Current job titles named as fast-growing in recent labour-market reports, each mapped to the O*NET occupation that does that work (O*NET's own title search first, maintainer judgement where it was clearly wrong; see note). 'declining' lists roles the WEF Future of Jobs Report 2025 names as fastest-declining worldwide (US declines are already shown as BLS figures). Display only; never part of the match score. Refresh by hand about once a year when new editions come out.

confidence_key.onet: O*NET's own title search returns this code first, or the title is an O*NET alternate title of the code
confidence_key.close: clear best fit, but O*NET's search ranks it below 1st or returns keyword noise
confidence_key.loose: role straddles occupations; 'alt' gives the second code

rising.title: AI Engineer
rising.note: O*NET search returns 15-1221.00 (research scientists) first and Software Developers third. Most AI Engineer ads are about building and shipping LLM/agent applications, which fits Software Developers best; ML-model-heavy roles fit Data Scientists, where O*NET files 'Machine Learning Engineer'. German 'KI-Entwickler' merged here.
